en.headline: Harbour City Toy Story carnival enters its last two days
en.dek: FOREVER TOYS at the Tsim Sha Tsui complex, built around Toy Story 5, is scheduled to end on Monday after a summer run that began in June.
body: Harbour City said its FOREVER TOYS programme, staged around Disney and Pixar’s Toy Story 5, runs until 31 August at the Tsim Sha Tsui waterfront mall after opening on 19 June.

Displays have included a 4.5-metre Buzz Lightyear figure on the Ocean Terminal deck and two-metre sculptures of Woody, Jessie and Bullseye at the Ocean Terminal forecourt. An official pop-up, The Forever Toy House, is listed at the Ocean Terminal main concourse from noon to 8pm.

The mall said game cards and related charity sales raise funds for Make-A-Wish Hong Kong after costs. Sunday workshops at the Ocean Terminal atrium were advertised from noon to 8pm. Admission to the public displays is free; some games and merchandise are charged separately.

zh.headline: 海港城《反斗奇兵》嘉年華進入最後兩日
zh.dek: 以《反斗奇兵5》為題的FOREVER TOYS活動由6月舉行至周一結束，海運大廈及港威商場仍設打卡裝置及主題店。
body: 海港城表示，以迪士尼彼思《反斗奇兵5》為題的FOREVER TOYS活動由6月19日舉行至8月31日，覆蓋尖沙咀海運大廈及港威商場多個位置。
場內包括海運觀點約4.5米高的巴斯光年裝置，以及海運大廈露天廣場約兩米高的胡迪、翠絲及紅心雕塑。官方主題店「The Forever Toy House」設於海運大廈地下展覽大堂，開放時間中午12時至晚上8時。
主辦方指部分遊戲卡及相關義賣扣除成本後撥捐願望成真基金。周日海運大廈地下中庭仍有工作坊，中午12時至晚上8時。公眾裝置免費參觀，部分遊戲及商品另行收費。
